title: Site01 projected-DEM local terrain-shadow replay snapshot

reference_epoch.epoch_precision_note: UTC is stored to the selected second; SPICE ET is preserved from the calculation output.

coordinate_system.longitude_direction: No player-facing longitude is inferred; longitude is an internal variable of the documented inverse only.

algorithm.edge_handling: stop at first invalid/out-of-raster sample and flag edge_truncated
algorithm.idealized_horizon_test: positive Sun elevation above the mapped local radial direction
algorithm.local_terrain_test: highest sampled terrain elevation along the horizontal Sun azimuth exceeds the idealized Sun elevation by more than the margin threshold
algorithm.height_application: observer point is placed at 1 m or 5 m above the DEM surface; terrain samples remain on the DEM surface

frame_and_geometry_notes: The GeoTIFF is not passed to a SPICE DSK routine.
The SPICE Sun direction is queried in MOON_ME_DE421 and the projected terrain is mapped into that frame using the documented spherical inverse.
The result is a team-computed terrain-ray classification using NASA-sourced inputs, not a NASA-published point measurement.
A 5 m raster pixel is not interpreted as a direct LOLA laser observation; LDEC and uncertainty layers are retained as quality context.

sampled_time_series.interpretation: These are 15-minute sampled intervals. First and last sampled shadow timestamps are not exact continuous astronomical transition boundaries.

uncertainty_method.clone_selection: Three explicitly available clone surfaces were tested.
uncertainty_method.statistical_claim: No confidence interval or complete 100-clone analysis is claimed.
uncertainty_method.measurement_vs_uncertainty: Published uncertainty rasters and clone sensitivity are kept separate from measurement precision and from statistical confidence.

reproduction_status.phase_2_calculation: completed before freeze and represented by the referenced Phase 2 artifacts
reproduction_status.phase_3_validator: snapshot and replay validation only; no SPICE or DEM recomputation
